pages.en:
“You used a Command Spell yesterday, didn't you? Then this time it's my turn.

“I'll summon Saber first. If even she can't handle it, you can call Archer then! Now, how do I use a Command Spell!?”

pages.ja:
「
左手に意識を固めて。目は瞑った方がいい。
頭の中で自分の令呪の形をイメージして、するっと紐解くだけでいいわ。もちろん、解く時は命令をしながらよ」
pages.jaRuby:
「

頭の中で自分の令呪の形をイメージして、するっと紐解くだけでいいわ。もちろん、解く時は命令をしながらよ」
pages.en:
“…Concentrate your awareness in your left hand. It will be easier with your eyes closed.

“Picture the shape of your Command Spell in your mind, then simply let it unravel. And naturally, you must speak your command as you release it.”

！！！！」

pages.en:
I close my eyes.

There is no time to waste.

In the briefest instant, I clear my mind of every stray thought,

reach for the second stroke,

and—

“—Please. Come to me, Saber——!”

without hesitation, release the Command Spell upon my left hand.

“I have answered your summons.

“Master, what is the situation…? This must be grave if you used a Command Spell.”

“I… can't say for certain, but that is what I sense.

“The anchor of this bounded field is on the first floor.”
